rules.statement: Every truth domain has exactly one owner; projections never write.
Installed artifacts never resolve to a repository checkout; repo paths appear only in development receipts.
rules.enforced_by: tests/test_ownership_contract.py + installer symlink audit (FALSIFICATION: recursive symlink and literal-path audit)

rules.statement: A resume attempt preserves identity and lineage; it never silently replaces the worker with a different persona.
Every visible control performs a real, authorized action or is absent.
rules.enforced_by: click-to-event integration tests (FALSIFICATION: controls are real)

rules.statement: Runtime gates are verified through the artifact the user actually runs.
rules.enforced_by: clean-machine artifact walk-around (FALSIFICATION: product is shippable)

rules.statement: Append-entries in plan-artifact files (tracker rows, decision addenda, journal lines) carry an inline HTML-comment provenance stamp with the same key set as commit-msg trailers. Server changes/checkpoints ledgers and AICX intents are projections of these stamps, never their source.
rules.stamp_format: <!-- provenance: source=<kind> agent=<agent> model=<model> session_id=<uuid> time=<iso8601> runtime=<runtime> -->

rules.statement: Code-care allocations govern repository-qualified, bounded agent maintenance responsibility only; they never create, alter, or compete with runtime truth ownership domains. Review roles may overlap without granting source scope or exclusive authorship.

Active configuration lives under ~/.config/vibecrafted/**; immutable runtime generations and selectors under ~/.local/share/vibecrafted; durable control, artifacts and history under ~/.vibecrafted. Ordinary startup consumes verified active generations without delivering or reinstalling.
rules.enforced_by: installer and app startup contract review
